duration_days.basis: Planning range across sub-services, not a sourced total. A Pune injection grouting listing on IndiaMART states 1–2 days and Pune APP membrane listings state about 5 days. Larger terrace, external wall and basement jobs take longer, and coatings need dry weather and drying time between coats.

questions_to_ask: Where exactly is the water coming from, and how did you confirm it (water test, moisture meter or opening up the area)?
Which system will you use: brand, product name, number of coats and quantity per sq ft?
Will you apply over the existing surface or remove old layers first, and why?
How will you treat cracks, construction joints, pipe openings, drain outlets and wall-floor junctions?
How will you measure the area, and are parapets, upturns and skirting included in the quoted sq ft?
Does the price include surface preparation, crack repair, any protective screed or tiles, debris removal, scaffolding and cleanup?
What warranty do you give in writing, who backs it (you or the manufacturer), and what does it exclude?
How will you test the work before handover, for example a ponding or flood test, and for how long?
common_mistakes: Comparing per-sq-ft rates without comparing scope; one quote may include crack repair, primer, extra coats and a protective layer while another does not.
Painting over a damp patch inside the home instead of fixing the source on the terrace, in the bathroom, on the external wall or in a pipe.
Applying a coating on a damp surface; Studio Matrx notes PU needs a bone-dry, primed surface because trapped moisture causes blisters.
Using a rigid cementitious coating where the surface moves or cracks; Studio Matrx gives two-component cementitious coatings 5–15% elongation, so they crack if the base cracks.
Skipping detailing at drain outlets, pipe openings, parapet junctions and wall-floor corners.
Leaving the work until the monsoon has started, when surfaces stay wet.
Accepting a verbal warranty, or one that does not name the product, the area and the exclusions.
quote_checklist: Area in sq ft and how it was measured (including parapets, upturns or skirting)
Cause of the leak and how it was diagnosed
System and products by brand and name, with number of coats
Surface preparation: cleaning, removal of loose or old layers, crack and joint repair
Detailing at drains, pipes, corners and junctions
Protective layer or finish (screed, tiles or top coat), if any
Testing before handover (ponding or flood test) and its duration
Written warranty: period, issuer and exclusions
Start date, duration and weather needed
Exclusions: tiling, plumbing, painting, scaffolding, debris removal
Payment schedule linked to stages of work

faq.q: How much does waterproofing cost in Pune?
faq.a: It depends on the area treated and the system. Our draft cost models, built from sources retrieved in October 2026 (many undated), give these per-sq-ft ranges: terrace ₹35–₹100 for coatings, ₹65–₹120 for liquid membranes, ₹25–₹160 for APP membrane and ₹80–₹300 for PU; bathrooms ₹40–₹200 per sq ft of treated area; external walls ₹25–₹150; basements ₹40–₹350. Injection grouting for a specific leak is priced per point, about ₹500–₹3,000. These are indicative ranges, not quotations.

faq.q: Who pays for terrace waterproofing in a housing society?
faq.a: In a Maharashtra co-operative housing society the terrace is a common area. Housing Society Times cites Bye-law No. 68 of the model bye-laws for this, which makes the society responsible for its upkeep and waterproofing. Check the bye-laws your society has adopted.

faq.q: When should waterproofing be done?
faq.a: In dry weather, before the monsoon. Coatings and membranes need a dry surface; Studio Matrx notes PU in particular needs a bone-dry, primed surface. If seepage shows during the monsoon, use that time to trace the source and plan the work.

faq.q: How long does waterproofing last?
faq.a: It depends on the system and the workmanship. Studio Matrx gives about 6–10 years for acrylic/liquid coatings, 8–12 years for two-component cementitious coatings, 10–15 years for APP/SBS sheet membranes and 12–20 years for PU. Aecord gives 6–10 years for torch-on APP/SBS membranes and 10–15 years for PU coatings. Ask for the warranty period in writing.

faq.q: Can a bathroom leak be fixed without breaking tiles?
faq.a: Sometimes. NoBroker lists 'basic coating + grouting' at ₹80–₹120 per sq ft. If water is getting into the sunken slab or a pipe is leaking, the floor usually has to be opened; NoBroker prices full sunken-slab treatment at ₹160–₹200 per sq ft.

faq.q: What is injection grouting?
faq.a: A repair in which grout is pumped into a leaking crack or joint through drilled ports. NoBroker recommends it for active water leaks, wall cracks and construction joints. It is usually priced per injection point.

faq.q: Why do waterproofing quotes vary so much?
faq.a: Quotes differ in scope (preparation, crack repair, number of coats, protective layer), product and surface condition. Pune listings show the spread: IndiaMART sellers advertise APP membrane work in Pune at mostly ₹25 to ₹80 per sq ft, while Leakfoe, a Pune contractor, calls ₹200–₹300 per sq ft the acceptable rate for residential terraces. Ask each contractor to price the same scope.

questions_to_ask: Is the terrace slope adequate, and will you correct low spots where water stands?
Will the existing tiles, screed or old coating be removed, or will the new system go over them?
How will you treat the parapet-to-slab junction, drain outlets and pipe or cable openings?

Will the finished surface stay exposed, or be covered with screed or tiles, and is that in the price?
Can the finished surface take foot traffic, water tank stands or solar panel frames?
How long will the ponding test run, and will you check the ceilings of the flats below?

Choosing only on the per-sq-ft rate without comparing expected life: Studio Matrx gives acrylic/liquid coatings 6–10 years and PU 12–20 years.
Letting water tanks, solar frames or heavy items be dragged over a fresh coating.
Skipping the ponding test before handover.

faq.q: What does terrace waterproofing cost in Pune per sq ft?
faq.a: It depends on the system. Our draft cost models, built from cited sources, give: acrylic coating ₹35–₹100 per sq ft (about ₹55 expected), liquid-applied membrane ₹65–₹120 (about ₹85), APP membrane ₹25–₹160 (about ₹90), brickbat coba ₹50–₹145 (about ₹85) and PU membrane ₹80–₹300 (about ₹215). NoBroker's Pune page lists terrace waterproofing at ₹35–₹60 per sq ft. These are indicative ranges, not quotations.

faq.q: How much would a 1,000 sq ft terrace cost?
faq.a: Multiply the rate by the measured area including parapet upturns. At the expected rates above, 1,000 sq ft comes to about ₹55,000 with an acrylic coating, ₹85,000 with a liquid membrane or brickbat coba, ₹90,000 with APP membrane and ₹2,15,000 with PU. Biddaro's Pune example puts a 1,000 sq ft terrace at ₹40,000–₹1,00,000 with crystalline or PU systems.

faq.q: Which terrace system should I choose?
faq.a: Coatings are the lowest-cost option and go over a sound existing surface. Liquid-applied membranes cure into a seamless, elastic layer. Aecord describes torch-on APP/SBS membranes as suited to older terraces with recurrent dampness. Studio Matrx describes PU as suited to exposed terraces and roof decks, with 300–500% elongation, but it needs a bone-dry, primed surface. Brickbat coba is a traditional method laid at construction or when the terrace is fully re-laid.

faq.q: Who pays for terrace waterproofing in a housing society?
faq.a: In a Maharashtra co-operative housing society the terrace is a common area. Housing Society Times cites Bye-law No. 68 of the model bye-laws for this, which makes the society responsible for its upkeep and waterproofing. Check the bye-laws your society has adopted and raise the work with the managing committee.

faq.q: How long does terrace waterproofing take?
faq.a: Plan for about 3–7 days on a 1,000 sq ft terrace in dry weather. Pune APP membrane listings on IndiaMART state about 5 days. Coatings need drying time between coats, and the job should end with a ponding test.

faq.q: What does bathroom waterproofing cost in Pune?
faq.a: Our draft models give ₹40–₹120 per sq ft of treated area for re-grouting and coating, ₹80–₹160 for floor and joints, and ₹90–₹200 for full sunken-slab treatment. Per-bathroom prices vary widely by scope: NoBroker's Pune page lists ₹2,000–₹4,000 per bathroom, and Studio Matrx gives ₹7,000 (budget) to ₹22,000 (luxury) for a typical 40 sq ft bathroom. These are indicative ranges, not quotations.

faq.q: Can a bathroom leak be fixed without breaking tiles?
faq.a: Sometimes. NoBroker lists 'basic coating + grouting' at ₹80–₹120 per sq ft, which works on the joints and surface. If water is getting into the sunken slab or a pipe is leaking, the floor usually has to be opened; NoBroker prices full treatment of the sunken slab, floor and joints at ₹160–₹200 per sq ft. Ask whether re-tiling is included.

faq.q: Why is labour such a large part of the price?
faq.a: Most of the work is preparation, careful application and testing. NoBroker states that labour is about 75% of the total cost of bathroom waterproofing.

faq.q: Should I choose a cementitious coating or a PU membrane?
faq.a: Studio Matrx notes cementitious coatings bond well to concrete and plaster but are rigid, so they crack if the base cracks; it recommends at least 2 coats and 3 in shower zones. PU membranes are flexible. Construction Estimator India prices PU membranes at ₹150–₹200 per sq ft and recommends them for bathrooms above the ground floor.

faq.q: What area is measured for bathroom waterproofing?
faq.a: The treated area is the floor plus the wall upturns and the shower zone, not just the floor. Studio Matrx's figures for a 40 sq ft bathroom work out to roughly 80–90 sq ft of treated area. Ask each contractor to state the area they measured.

faq.q: What does external wall waterproofing cost in Pune?
faq.a: Our draft models give ₹27–₹60 per sq ft for a waterproof coating only (about ₹45 expected), ₹25–₹100 for crack repair with an elastomeric coating (about ₹60) and ₹50–₹150 for premium systems (about ₹100). NoBroker's Pune page lists exterior wall waterproofing at ₹30–₹60 per sq ft. These are indicative ranges, not quotations.

faq.q: What is the difference between acrylic and elastomeric coatings?
faq.a: Asian Paints describes acrylic waterproof coatings as suited to moderate climates and budget-friendly, and elastomeric coatings as flexible and suited to cracks and harsh weather. Liquid membrane coatings give a seamless layer.

faq.q: Do cracks need to be repaired before coating?
faq.a: Yes. Coating over open cracks leaves a path for water. NoBroker prices crack filling plus an elastomeric coating at ₹35–₹80 per sq ft, and its Pune page lists crack filling on its own at ₹100–₹150 per running foot.

faq.q: What affects the price of external wall waterproofing?
faq.a: Asian Paints lists total wall area, surface condition, crack repair, the extent of seepage damage, the system chosen, the number of coats, labour and application complexity, and access to the building.

faq.q: Is a premium system worth it?
faq.a: It depends on the wall. NoBroker prices premium waterproof paint systems at ₹60–₹150 per sq ft against ₹35–₹60 for a basic waterproof coating. A wall with many cracks or heavy rain exposure gains more from a flexible, crack-bridging system; ask for the expected life and warranty in writing before choosing.

faq.q: What does basement waterproofing cost in Pune?
faq.a: Our draft models give ₹75–₹200 per sq ft for a cementitious treatment (about ₹130 expected), ₹40–₹320 for crystalline (about ₹150), ₹80–₹150 for an external membrane during construction (about ₹115) and ₹100–₹350 for injection grouting of active leaks (about ₹205). NoBroker's Pune page lists basement waterproofing at ₹75–₹100 per sq ft. These are indicative ranges, not quotations.

faq.q: Why does basement waterproofing cost more than other areas?
faq.a: Asian Paints notes basement work is more complex because underground moisture pressure is higher. Active leaks often need injection before any coating, which NoBroker prices at ₹180–₹350 per sq ft.

faq.q: Should a basement be waterproofed from inside or outside?
faq.a: For a new building, Studio Matrx describes an external membrane applied before backfilling as the most effective method. In an existing basement the outside is usually no longer reachable, so treatment is done from inside with cementitious or crystalline systems, with injection at active leaks.

faq.q: What is crystalline waterproofing?
faq.a: Chemicals in the coating react with water to grow crystals inside the concrete pores. Studio Matrx notes it self-seals fine cracks but works only in dense concrete and does not suit moving cracks. NoBroker describes it as suited to basements under strong water pressure.

faq.q: How is an active basement leak stopped?
faq.a: By injection grouting: grout is pumped into the crack or joint through drilled ports. NoBroker recommends it for active water leaks, wall cracks and construction joints.

faq.q: What does leakage repair by injection grouting cost in Pune?
faq.a: It is usually priced per injection point. Our draft model gives ₹500–₹3,000 per point, about ₹2,000 expected. NoBroker lists ₹500–₹1,200 per point for severe seepage, AapkaPainter ₹2,000–₹3,000 per nozzle, and a Pune seller on IndiaMART lists polymer injection grouting at ₹2,000 per injection onwards. These are indicative ranges, not quotations.

faq.q: Why do some contractors price injection grouting per sq ft?
faq.a: Contractors use different units. NoBroker also lists injection grouting at ₹180–₹350 per sq ft for basements. Ask for the number of points and a maximum total so quotes can be compared.

faq.q: How long does injection grouting take?
faq.a: A Pune polymer injection grouting listing on IndiaMART states 1–2 days. Re-plastering and painting may take longer once the area has dried.

faq.q: Will injection grouting stop the leak for good?
faq.a: It seals the crack or joint it is injected into. If water keeps reaching the structure from a failed terrace, bathroom or external wall, that source also needs repair, or water may find another path.

faq.q: What grout is used?
faq.a: Polyurethane (PU) grout is common for active leaks; AapkaPainter lists Dr. Fixit PU Grouting at ₹300 per kg. A Pune listing on IndiaMART offers polymer injection grouting using drilled holes. Ask the contractor to name the product.
